correctness.rationale: The complete Ge-Li-Li preprint was inspected. Their equations (2.4)-(2.7), (3.2) in even dimension, and (3.7)-(3.11) in odd dimension give exactly the nonnegative Lipschitz-Killing expansion used here. Rewriting (3.2) with Scal=n(n-1)+2 tr(E) yields the even volume-deficit identity, while the odd boundary inequality yields its inequality analogue. Since E>=0, tr(E) is the Schatten-1 norm and dominates every Schatten norm. Lemma 2.1 plus H_j(Id)=1 gives H_j(E)>=lambda_min(E)^j. The round-sphere sharpness calculations are direct. Thus the mathematics is correct.
